dinniman: Introducing the Everything Bundle! Every Outsider perk AND every Outsider curse, all in one convenient, terrifying package! Do you hold every Outsider ability on the script at once?

plain: Do you believe you're a good character, when you're secretly a Minion?
dinniman: Worst way to go I ever saw: a crawler who found out at the very end he'd been working for the other side the whole time. Do you believe you're a good character, when you're secretly a Minion?

plain: Is your whole role believing that you're the Demon, when you aren't?
dinniman: Confidence is EVERYTHING, darling. I am certain I'm the star, and some of you are certain you're the big bad Demon. One of us is right. Is your whole role believing you're the Demon, when you aren't?

plain: If the Demon dies by execution, does the game carry on for one more day because of you?
dinniman: Fools! You think killing my master ends this? There is a PLAN behind the plan, and I have ONE MORE DAY to see it through! If the Demon dies by execution, does the game carry on for one more day because of you?

plain: Each night, do you pick a living player who won't die if they're executed tomorrow?
dinniman: Our legal department has found a loophole! Tomorrow's guest of honour can be hanged and walk away completely fine! Each night, do you pick a living player who won't die if they're executed tomorrow?

plain: Each night, do you pick a player and a good character they must pretend to be tomorrow, or risk execution?
dinniman: I do love a bit of method acting, darling. Commit to the role, or the audience turns on you. Each night, do you pick a player and a good character they must pretend to be tomorrow, or risk execution?

plain: Is there one night when all the Townsfolk are poisoned because of you?
dinniman: ONE GLORIOUS NIGHT! Every Townsfolk wakes up useless and doesn't even know it! Samantha calls it a holiday! Is there one night when all the Townsfolk are poisoned because of you?

plain: Once per game, do you choose a dead player to get their ability back until dusk?
dinniman: Mongo! (Mongo has dug up a bone and is extremely pleased with himself.) Translation: once per game, do you choose a dead player to get their ability back until dusk?

plain: Once a day, can you kill a living neighbour, if your other neighbour agrees?
dinniman: In my day you settled disputes with the people next door with a casserole and a grudge. This is quicker. Once a day, can you kill a living neighbour, if your other neighbour agrees?

plain: Can you win for good by publicly naming exactly which players are the Minions and which are the Demons?
dinniman: Sometimes you just know, deep down, who the monsters are. Saying it out loud takes courage. Can you win for good by publicly naming exactly which players are the Minions and which are the Demons?

plain: Are you safe from the Demon, even though other things can still kill you?
dinniman: MONGO! (Mongo has bitten the Demon. The Demon tried to bite back and could not. Mongo is delighted.) Are you safe from the Demon, even though other things can still kill you?
